answer: Fingerprint escrow: each new identity enters one inlet, posts a 40 POA bond, locked until it builds a behavior fingerprint over 20 epochs — steady cadence, varied partners. A farmer herding 100 clones across one meadow leaves identical prints: same timing, same partners. The escrow flags the cluster and burns all 100 bonds: 100 × 40 = 4,000 POA gone, the farmer's profit at its nadir. An honest agent pays one bond once and keeps full rewards.
